email.subject: How to tell a good relief STL from a bad one before you waste a board
email.intro:
Most relief STL files for sale have never been carved by the person selling them. They look fine in a viewer. They look great in the listing picture. They fall apart on a real router, usually around hour two.

We rewrote our guide to judging a file before you buy it, or before you commit a board to one you already own: the one signal that predicts a good carve, the five-minute inspection with free tools, and the seven red flags you can see on the listing alone.
